svg.aria-label: Nine quality measures for six upscalers, each as dots on its own scale; the steady test build is the one this page is about. Still picture (accuracy, dB; higher is better): FSR 4.1.1 (= exact) 44.3, Steady test 44.4, Lossy 44.3, FSR 3.1 39.9, HelixSR 42.0, XeSS 42.1. Shimmer at rest (change per frame, of 255; lower is better): FSR 4.1.1 (= exact) 0.037, Steady test 0.026, Lossy 0.024, FSR 3.1 0.014, HelixSR 0.020, XeSS 0.084. Moving background (accuracy, dB; higher is better): FSR 4.1.1 (= exact) 49.3, Steady test 49.4, Lossy 49.1, FSR 3.1 48.0, HelixSR 46.9, XeSS 47.7. Moving background (change per frame, of 255; lower is better): FSR 4.1.1 (= exact) 0.079, Steady test 0.067, Lossy 0.024, FSR 3.1 0.077, HelixSR 0.193, XeSS 0.085. Just-uncovered areas (accuracy in motion, dB; higher is better): FSR 4.1.1 (= exact) 34.5, Steady test 34.4, Lossy 36.5, FSR 3.1 29.2, HelixSR 27.1, XeSS 30.2. Tiny fast sparks (share of brightness shown, %; higher is better): FSR 4.1.1 (= exact) 83, Steady test 83, Lossy 75, FSR 3.1 40, HelixSR 79, XeSS 50. Swaying foliage (error, of 255; lower is better): FSR 4.1.1 (= exact) 12.1, Steady test 12.2, Lossy 18.6, FSR 3.1 16.8, HelixSR 15.5, XeSS 15.5. Thin wire, slow pan (change per frame, of 255; lower is better): FSR 4.1.1 (= exact) 7.2, Steady test 7.2, Lossy 14.6, FSR 3.1 8.2, HelixSR 5.6, XeSS 10.1. Film grain (10 of 255) (change per frame, of 255; lower is better): FSR 4.1.1 (= exact) 1.72, Steady test 1.72, Lossy 1.08, FSR 3.1 0.31, HelixSR 0.30, XeSS 0.23.
svg.text: Picture quality: the steady test build among the others
Each panel has its own scale. The better end of every scale is on the right. Test rig, 4K output, one card.
